derivedFrom: Original frozen meanings and approved metadata, plus explicit user scorer-correction instructions. Fixtures labelled before implementing v2 scorer.
rules: US and USA are equivalent only when metadata identifies the same national entity. State/country collisions remain distinct.

Ordered geography and pair arrays are authoritative. Null singular summaries are allowed when arrays preserve meaning; nonnull contradictory summaries still fail. A summary may name a requested member without changing array order.
Missing frequency defaults to annual and missing explicit to false. Explicitly requested monthly/annual must still match. No unstated sector.
Semantic extraction reads existing nested value fields without rewriting answers; their structural violations remain contract failures. No extraction or repair of malformed/fenced/concatenated JSON.
Offsets are judged only by the unchanged source-evidence validator. Semantic scope decisions use literal scope text/status; wrong offsets alone do not imply wrong meaning.
Geography exclusions can be semantically expressed in scopes or flat lists even if their shape violates the output contract. Excluded countries in positive arrays or requested scopes remain failures.
No arbitrary geography/product/activity exceptions. Country/state interpretation follows foreign-country/international context for ambiguous names.
Gas must remain unresolved and specifically distinguish natural gas from gasoline/petrol. Guesses or generic gas-related ambiguity fail.
Truncations, API failures and malformed/nonobject JSON are labelled ungradable, retained in every scheduled denominator, and separated from observed semantic mistakes.
Contract metrics retain original strict JSON/shape/source-span checks. No app repair upgrades model grades.
